PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to confirm downstream biology changes from DNA damage, microtubule stabilization, or thymidylate synthase inhibition. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint (treatment completion rate) was not met - paclitaxel arm achieved 67% vs fluorouracil arm 53%, but no p-value reported and the trial is classified as failed. Complete response rates were 72% vs 62% but again no statistical significance reported. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This appears to be a head-to-head comparison of two combination regimens rather than a placebo-controlled trial testing a specific mechanism. The primary endpoint (treatment completion rate) is more of a tolerability/feasibility measure than an efficacy endpoint. The trial lacks statistical power assessment and p-values for the reported differences.
